theorems.name: Submission.smr_riesz_borel_euclidean
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ L : (Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) → ℝ, (∀ f g : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → L (f + g) = L f + L g) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → L (c • f) = c * L f) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ f : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → L f ≤ B) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ν : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), Measurable ν ∧ μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ x, ‖ν x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ f : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (f x) (ν x)) μ ∧ L f = ∫ x, inner ℝ (f x) (ν x) ∂μ
